author: kalo9480
content:
So shall I assume there's no consensus on that topic and we should be ready to have different building times per CL client for mainnet?
My 2 cents are that a block's value that a CL client can build shouldn't be part of the equation when operators choose a client type. And given that past months the profit margins got quite thin, I'm afraid this can become (one of) the main drivers when making a choice.

author: potuz
content: It seems that bid selection is a hot topic now and there's plenty of opnionated versions out there, I hope we could get to a sane defaults for all clients, but I don't have high hopes of that happening soon.
